data.name: Judie
data.gender_notes: Judie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Judah, meaning 'praised'. In the New Testament, Judas Iscariot is a disciple who betrays Jesus. The name Judie is a feminine variation and carries a gentle, Judean meaning. The name Judie carries the meaning “Gentle, Judean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Judie usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, judean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's unwavering love and grace, even in the face of betrayal.
data.etymology: Judie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Judean.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Judie total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: ג'ודי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ג'ודי הוא שם שמקורו במקרא, ומשמעותו 'יהוה הוא ישוע' או 'הוא שמחה'. השם ג'ודי נגזר מהשם העברי 'יהודה', שפירושו 'יהוה הוא ישוע' או 'הוא מודה לאלוהים'. השם היה מאוד פופולרי בקרב יהודים וגם בקרב נוצרים, והוא נושא משמעות רבה בהיסטוריה היהודית והנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Τζούντι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζούντι είναι ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Ιούδα (Ιουδάς), που σημαίνει 'δόξα Θεού' ή 'Χαρά και δόξα Θεού'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Ιούδα αναφέρεται σε έναν από τους αποστόλους του Ιησού και σε άλλους πρόσωπα. Το όνομα Τζούντι έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους και θεωρείται σύμβολο πνευματικής χαράς και αφοσίωσης.

in_latin.name: Judie
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Judie originem habet in nomine hebraeo 'Iehudah', quod significat 'Deus est gratia' vel 'confessio Dei'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Iuda vel Iudas in contextu christiano usitatum erat, designans gratiam et laetitiam spiritualem. Nomen Judie per saecula in traditione christiana usitatum est, significans donum Dei et gaudium spirituale.

in_english.name: Judie
in_english.meaning: Praise to God or He will be praised

It is associated with Judah, one of the twelve tribes of Israel and a significant figure in the Old Testament. In Christian tradition, Judie symbolizes spiritual joy, gratitude, and devotion to God. The name has been popularized across cultures, reflecting its timeless significance and universal appeal.
